gloss: to log out; to sign out

definitions.gloss: to log out; to sign out
definitions.explanation: To end one's authenticated session on a computer system, website, or online service, disconnecting the current account until the user logs in again.

examples.japanese: アカウントからログアウトする。
examples.english: To log out of one's account.

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}が{終|お}わったらログアウトしてください。
examples.english: Please log out when you are done with your work.

examples.japanese: {共用|きょうよう}のパソコンでは{必|かなら}ずログアウトしてから{席|せき}を{離|はな}れよう。
examples.english: On a shared computer, always log out before you leave your seat.

examples.japanese: {一定|いってい}{時間|じかん}{操作|そうさ}しないと、{自動的|じどうてき}にログアウトされる。
examples.english: If there is no activity for a set period of time, you will be automatically logged out.

notes:
The standard verb for ending a login session on a computer account, website, or online service. Borrowed from English "log out." ログアウト can be used alone as a noun, and する makes it a verb. The opposite of ログインする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アカウントからログアウトする: to log out of an account
- ログアウト{画面|がめん}: logout screen
- ログアウトボタン: logout button
- {自動|じどう}ログアウト: automatic logout
- {強制|きょうせい}ログアウト: forced logout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サインアウトする: to sign out — used by some services (e.g., Microsoft); functionally equivalent
- {切断|せつだん}する: to disconnect — broader; used for any network connection, not just authenticated sessions

RELATED WORDS:
- ログインする: to log in — the opposite action
- ログイン{情報|じょうほう}: login credentials

USAGE:
The particle から marks what you log out of: サイトからログアウトする (log out of a site). Often used in security advice for shared or public computers.
